title: SEMI’s supply chain survey saw the memory shortage four months early. Now it’s quarterly.
gist: A Beebolt employee promotes SEMI's new Quarterly Pulse Survey on lead times, supply agreements and inventory, noting SEMI's annual Semiconductor Supply Chain Survey detected the memory shortage in June 2025, four months before mainstream news.
